physical_location_concentration.interpretation: The 733 heldout deployment rows are repeated deployment units at only 27 named physical locations. The activity failure is therefore highly concentrated in one source/location domain rather than representing 733 independent geographic sites.

annotation_metadata_shift.interpretive_limit: Different metadata completeness, setup personnel and annotation personnel establish a source-domain shift. They do not establish that camera protocol or classification practice caused the E4 activity failure.

calendar_overlap.interpretation: The source-domain shift is not reducible to completely non-overlapping calendar years.

observation_model_vulnerability.implication: Any real source-specific change in effective camera detection or annotation-to-event yield is outside the fitted observation model and can be absorbed by the ecological activity channel. E4 therefore cannot identify behavioral nonstationarity separately from observation-process nonstationarity in this heldout source domain.

ecological_context.interpretation: Nocturnal elevation remains present in the heldout D stratum, but its magnitude is much weaker than in training. The failure is therefore not simply absence of the known nocturnal pattern.

supported: The E4 activity failure is a domain-transfer failure concentrated in a small number of physical source locations rather than a uniform failure across 733 independent sites.
The geographic east holdout is entangled with a strong deployment-metadata and annotation-metadata source shift.
Because annotated-stream detection is fixed at one, E4 cannot separate source-specific effective detectability from ecological activity when the observation domain changes.
The retained nocturnal signal and the large change in its magnitude are compatible with either ecological nonstationarity, observation-process nonstationarity, or both.
hypotheses_for_independent_future_data: Conditional muskrat activity is regionally or contextually nonstationary, with more daytime/cathemeral activity in the high-event eastern source domain.
Effective camera detectability or event annotation yield differs across source domains and is partly absorbed into the fitted activity process.
Both ecological activity and observation process change across domains, so a future design must cross geography with survey source rather than confound them.
not_supported: A causal observer, classifier, camera-height, or detection-distance effect.
Proof that activity is biologically irrelevant.
Changing the frozen E4 activity/state support decisions.
Rerunning, retuning, switching backend, or authorizing Laplace/INLA.
